secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.description: Cloudflare account ID (32 hex chars) containing your D1 database — find it in the Cloudflare dashboard sidebar

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_D1_DATABASE_ID
secrets.description: UUID of your Cloudflare D1 database — find it in Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers & Pages > D1

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Cloudflare API token with Account / D1 / Edit permission — create at Cloudflare > My Profile > API Tokens

secrets.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: A random secret (32+ chars, no whitespace) shared with your MCP client to authenticate /mcp requests — generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`
